content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Bachelor’s and Master’s Degrees in relevant disciplines. First Class in either of the two degrees. The qualification will be as per UGC Regulations, 2018. For subject-specific teaching posts, candidates must fulfil the required educational qualifications prescribed by UGC. Post Graduate degree in the relevant subject with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. B.Ed. degree with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. NET/SLET or Ph.D. as prescribed by UGC for these categories of posts. UG degree in Science or Engineering with minimum 55% marks and 5 years research experience in Food/Water testing or Food/Water Testing Laboratory experience. OR PG degree in Science or Engineering with minimum 55% marks and 4 years research experience in Food/Water testing. Bachelor’s degree in relevant subject with minimum two years working and maintenance experience of sophisticated scientific instruments in a laboratory. Relevant subjects include Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Medical/Health Sciences, Biotechnology and Bioinformatics. 10+2 with Science stream from recognized board. OR 10th Pass with Science as one subject and two years laboratory experience.

content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Salary Structure 2026

rows.emoluments: Rs. 1,000 per lecture (Maximum Rs. 50,000 per month)

content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Duration
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary and contractual. The duration varies according to the post. Contractual Faculty: As per notification terms. Senior Analyst: One Year. Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant: 89 Days.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the CUPB recruitment portal. Select the desired post. Complete the online application form. Upload required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Submit the application before the last date. Attend the interview with required original documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CUPB Interview
content_sections.text: Printed copy of online application form Educational qualification certificates and marksheets Experience certificates Appointment letters/pay slips, if applicable Caste certificate for reserved categories No Objection Certificate, if applicable Two passport size photographs Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through walk-in interview for the advertised posts. Document Verification Interview Presentation may be required for certain positions

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No separate call letters will be sent for interviews. Candidates must attend the interview at the designated venue and date. Original documents must be produced during verification. The university will not provide regular appointment/absorption rights for contractual posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive for various contractual teaching and non-teaching positions including Faculty, Senior Analyst, Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available in CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Contractual Faculty, Part-Time Faculty, Senior Analyst, Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of CUPB Senior Analyst?
faq.answer: The Senior Analyst post carries emoluments of Rs. 65,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the CUPB recruitment portal and attend the interview as per the schedule.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CUPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100 for candidates other than SC/ST/PWD/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Laboratory Assistant in CUPB?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Bachelor’s degree in the relevant subject along with two years of experience in maintenance of sophisticated scientific instruments.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for Laboratory Attendant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have 10+2 with Science stream or 10th pass with Science subject and two years laboratory experience.
